verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a design-tool integration, such as Figma or Adobe, or any way to update monday.com item status from inside a design app. The integration directory lists sales, dev, communication, support and marketing categories only. Generic claims of 850+ integrations, 2-way sync with 'any platform' and a GraphQL API are developer building blocks or unrelated categories, not this capability.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps
